title: 🛡️ Safety Gate

green.label: 🟢 LEARN
green.meaning: General educational information may be appropriate based on the information provided.
green.message: Your answers do not indicate an obvious urgent situation from the information provided. You can review general information and continue monitoring how you feel.

yellow.label: 🟡 DISCUSS
yellow.meaning: The concern may be worth discussing with a trusted adult or healthcare professional.
yellow.message: Your concern may be worth discussing with a trusted adult or healthcare professional, especially if it continues, becomes more concerning, or is different from your usual experience.

red.label: 🔴 ACT
red.meaning: Prompt medical attention may be appropriate.
red.message: Some symptoms can require prompt medical attention. Tell a trusted adult and seek appropriate medical care promptly.

critical_rule: Never present a safety level as a diagnosis. Do not claim certainty.
